column4: Beginner clues generate a minimum of 1 reward and a maximum of 3, granting an average of 2 rewards per casket. On average it will take 597 beginner clues to obtain every unique, not counting the black pickaxe which you can get from easy clues at a higher rate.

Easy clues generate a minimum of 2 rewards and a maximum of 4, granting an average of 3 rewards per casket. Additionally, players have a 1/50 chance to receive a master clue scroll upon opening an easy casket. Chance of a clue scroll unique item from an easy casket is 247/1080, or roughly 22.9%.

Medium clues generate a minimum of 3 rewards and a maximum of 5, granting an average of 4 rewards per casket. Additionally, players have a 1/30 chance to receive a master clue scroll upon opening a medium casket. On average, it will take 2076 reward caskets to obtain all the unique drops specific to medium clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers).

Hard clues generate a minimum of 4 rewards and a maximum of 6, granting an average of 5 rewards per casket. Additionally, players have a 1/15 chance of receiving a master clue scroll upon opening a hard casket. On average, it will take 5484 reward caskets to obtain all the (non-mega-rare) unique drops specific to hard clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers). Chance of a clue scroll unique item from a hard casket is 5x 1/12.5, which becomes 1/2.93 or 34.1%.

Elite clues generate a minimum of 4 rewards and a maximum of 6, granting an average of 5 rewards per casket. Additionally, players have a 1/5 chance to receive a master clue scroll upon opening an elite casket - this does not take up one of the 4-6 reward slots.

Master clues generate a minimum of 5 rewards and a maximum of 7, granting an average of 6 rewards per casket. Additionally, players have a 1/1,000 chance to receive the Bloodhound pet upon opening a master casket.
